features.summary: Some form-control layout tests that had been disabled on Macs with Apple silicon are enabled again now that they pass there. This restores test coverage without changing how controls behave for users.

features.label: MathML

patches.author: tannal
patches.subject: Avoid integer overflow when layouting mpadded using voffset or lspace.

features.summary: MathML layout now guards against integer overflow when `mpadded` uses `voffset` or `lspace` values. This prevents extreme or malformed mathematical markup from producing incorrect dimensions or destabilizing layout. **MathML pages are safer and more predictable when padding offsets are unusually large.**

features.label: Media IPC

patches.author: Hiroyuki Ikezoe
patches.subject: Track each pipeline's embedder LayersId in CompositorBridgeParent::LayerTreeState.

features.summary: Media IPC now records the compositor `LayersId` associated with each media pipeline’s embedder. This gives Firefox’s media and graphics processes the tracking information needed to associate video layers with the correct compositor tree, improving reliability for rendered media.

features.label: Other

patches.author: Mark Banner
patches.subject: Rename remaining browser/base/content/test browser-chrome directories to match eslint-test-paths conventions

features.summary: Remaining browser-chrome test directories were renamed to follow Firefox’s `eslint-test-paths` conventions. There is no user-visible change, but test discovery and linting are now more consistent.

features.label: Printing & print preview

patches.author: Emilio Cobos Álvarez
patches.subject: Remove MOZ_ENABLE_SKIA_PDF.

features.summary: Firefox removed the `MOZ_ENABLE_SKIA_PDF` build option, eliminating a legacy switch for selecting Skia PDF support. This simplifies the printing and print-preview build configuration while keeping printing itself available. _The change is primarily internal and should not alter normal print-preview use._

features.label: Table layout

patches.author: Emilio Cobos Álvarez
patches.subject: Missed one crashtest.

features.summary: A missing crash test was added for Firefox’s table layout code. This helps catch cases where table rendering could make the browser crash.
